name: Hand Axe
description: A compact axe with a sturdy haft and razor-sharp edge for brutal close combat.

name: Dagger
description: A short, double-edged blade useful for defense, duels, or daily survival tasks.

name: Large Shield
description: A heavy shield reinforced with iron, its surface scarred by blades and arrows alike.

name: Cavalry Hammer
description: A hammer designed for mounted knights, its blunt head able to crush armor while a spike pierces through helmets.

name: Cavalry Lance
description: A long wooden lance designed to deliver devastating charges that pierce armor and scatter enemy lines.

name: Rapier
description: A slender dueling sword, its blade perfect for thrusts, flourishes, and lethal precision strikes.

name: Knuckledusters
description: Simple but brutal iron rings fitted to the fist, favored by tavern brawlers and thieves for close and vicious fighting.

name: Grain Flail
description: A converted farming tool turned into a weapon, its chain and wooden staff capable of striking with surprising force.

name: Military Flail
description: A weaponized flail with spiked heads, crafted for war, capable of smashing shields and breaking enemy lines.

name: Main Gauche
description: A parrying dagger with an extended guard, commonly used alongside a rapier to deflect and counter strikes in duels.

name: Swordbreaker
description: A dagger with deep notches designed to catch and snap enemy blades, favored by duelists and rogues.

name: Halberd
description: A polearm combining axe blade, spear tip, and hook to deal with armored enemies and cavalry alike.

name: Spear
description: A versatile weapon with a pointed steel head, effective in ranks or thrown at short range.

name: Quarterstaff
description: A simple wooden staff used for training and self-defense, effective in skilled hands at keeping foes at bay.

name: Bastard Sword
description: A versatile longsword wielded with one or two hands, valued for its balance between power and control.

name: Great Axe
description: A massive, brutal two-handed axe warped by dark runes, carried by warriors who revel in destruction on the battlefield.

name: Warhammer
description: A two-handed hammer bearing engravings and designed to crush armor and skulls with righteous fury.

name: Zweihander
description: A massive two-handed sword capable of sweeping blows that can cleave through multiple foes.

name: Long Rifle
description: A prized firearm with intricate mechanisms and deadly accuracy across battlefield distances.

name: Handgun
description: A blackpowder firearm firing deadly lead shot capable of piercing armor, though slow to reload.

name: Pistol
description: A compact blackpowder firearm, deadly at close range but often unreliable.

name: War Bow
description: An elegant, finely crafted bow of gleaming wood, its draw smooth and precise, with deadly accuracy from great distances.

name: Longbow
description: A tall yew longbow renowned for its range and accuracy, used in hunting and on the battlefield against armored foes.

name: Shortbow
description: A simple shortbow, easy to draw and fire quickly, often carried by scouts, hunters, and militias for skirmishing.

name: Crossbow Pistol
description: An ingenious contraption, this compact crossbow pistol allows concealed yet deadly shots, favored by assassins and mercenaries alike.

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: A powerful two-handed crossbow capable of piercing armor, slow to reload but devastating in the hands of trained marksmen.

name: Repeater Handgun
description: A rare and ingenious firearm that can fire multiple shots before reloading, valued highly by wealthy officers and noble hunters.

name: Whip
description: A flexible leather lash used by beastmasters and guards, capable of striking at range or controlling unruly foes.

name: Bomb
description: A dangerous blackpowder device, crudely crafted but capable of wreaking havoc with fire, smoke, and deadly shrapnel.

name: Sling
description: A simple leather sling hurling stones with surprising force against lightly armored foes.

name: Staff Sling
description: A two-handed sling mounted on a staff, capable of launching stones farther and harder than a simple hand sling.

name: Bolas
description: A throwing weapon of weighted cords, designed to entangle legs and bring down prey or fleeing enemies with precision.

name: Throwing Dart
description: Small and easily concealed, these darts can be hurled quickly and silently, favored by rogues and assassins.

name: Javelin
description: A light spear designed for throwing, carried by skirmishers and hunters, effective at harassing enemy ranks.

name: Throwing Axe
description: A balanced axe designed to be hurled with deadly accuracy, often used in raids and ambushes.

name: Throwing Knife
description: A set of balanced knives designed for throwing, often hidden beneath cloaks and favored by rogues and hired killers.

name: Claymore
description: A massive two-handed sword with a broad blade, favored by fierce warriors for devastating sweeps in battle.

name: Gauntlet Knuckle-Duster
description: A brutal iron gauntlet reinforced with spikes across the knuckles, crafted for close-quarters brawling.

name: Halberd
description: A long polearm tipped with an axe blade and spear point, ideal for breaking cavalry charges and holding lines.

name: Lance
description: A long ash shaft tipped with a steel point, designed for devastating charges from horseback.

name: Morning Star
description: A cruel spiked ball mounted on a stout haft, capable of crushing armor with a single blow.

name: Rapier
description: A slender blade with ornate hilt, prized by duelists and nobles for speed and precision.

name: Long Spear
description: A sturdy spear with a long ash shaft, favored by militias for reach and defense.

name: Garrotte
description: A simple length of wire or cord, deadly in the hands of an assassin when used from the shadows.

name: Kislev Berdysh
description: A heavy, curved axe-blade fixed to a long shaft, wielded by Kislevite warriors for brutal cleaving strikes.

name: Cathayan Sword
description: An elegant curved blade from Cathay, finely balanced and treasured by collectors and duelists alike.

name: Cathayan Longsword
description: A masterwork longsword from Cathay, forged with rare techniques and imbued with flawless balance.

name: Elven Battle-Axe
description: A gleaming axe of elegant elven make, combining deadly grace with brutal efficiency in war.

name: Kopesh
description: A curved blade of ancient Khemri design, often wielded in ritual combat or by Araby mercenaries.

name: Pavise
description: A towering shield from Tilea, designed to cover crossbowmen as they reload amidst battle.

name: Tilean Pike
description: A long spear used in the disciplined ranks of Tilean mercenaries, perfect for keeping foes at bay.

name: White Wolf Hammer
description: A mighty warhammer blessed by the cult of Ulric, wielded by the fearsome White Wolves of Middenheim.

name: Wood Elf Hunting Spear
description: A finely crafted spear of ash and moonsteel, designed by wood elves for both hunting and battle.

name: Elven Bow
description: A graceful longbow of elven craft, its string singing with unmatched accuracy and range.

name: Kislev Recurve Bow
description: A compact recurve bow from Kislev, prized for its power and accuracy even from horseback.

name: Kislev Recurve Shortbow
description: A lighter recurve shortbow from Kislev, favored by hunters and skirmishers for quick volleys.

name: 12 Arrows
description: A bundle of straight-fletched arrows, standard issue for hunters and soldiers alike.

name: 12 Armor Piercing Arrows
description: A quiver of arrows tipped with hardened steel heads, designed to pierce through mail and plate.

name: 12 Bolts
description: A dozen stout crossbow bolts, effective against both beasts and men in battle.

name: 12 Steel-Tipped Bolts
description: Crossbow bolts reinforced with sharp steel heads, built to shatter shields and armor.

name: Blowgun
description: A simple reed tube used to silently fire darts, favored by hunters and assassins alike.

name: Long Blowgun
description: A longer blowgun with extended range, deadly in the hands of skilled stalkers.

name: Blowgun Dart
description: A small wooden dart for use with a blowgun, often tipped with sharpened bone or steel.

name: Blowgun Precision Dart
description: A finely balanced dart designed for blowguns, deadly accurate when used by trained hands.

name: 10 Clay Round Shots
description: A pouch of crude clay pellets, cheap and commonly used as sling ammunition.

name: 10 Lead Round Shots
description: Dense lead pellets used with slings, delivering heavy blows on impact.

name: 10 Iron Round Shots
description: A set of iron pellets forged for use with slings, heavier and deadlier than clay or lead.

name: 10 Steel Round Shots
description: Well-crafted steel pellets, prized for their durability and lethal impact in sling warfare.

name: 10 Grams of Gunpowder
description: A small pouch of fine black powder, volatile and essential for early firearms and explosives.

name: Plague Censer
description: A foul Skaven weapon, a spiked iron ball on a chain filled with choking pestilential fumes.

name: Punch Dagger
description: A vicious Skaven blade strapped across the fist, made for sudden and lethal strikes.

name: Rat Claws
description: Crude Skaven claw-blades worn over the hands, mimicking the verminous beasts’ natural weapons.

name: Tail Blade
description: A wicked Skaven blade affixed to the tail, allowing deadly surprise strikes in battle.
